STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_222695.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_222695.v · Open raw
module origen_222695 (
    input wire [15:0] w_data,
    input wire [3:0] w_addr,
    input wire commit,
    input wire clk12p5,
    output wire sclk,
    output wire sdata,
    output wire scs,
    output wire busy
);

reg [15:0] data_reg;
reg [3:0] addr_reg;
reg commit_reg;
reg sclk_reg;
reg sdata_reg;
reg scs_reg;
reg busy_reg;

reg [4:0] sclk_counter;
reg [3:0] data_counter;

always @(posedge clk12p5) begin
    data_reg <= w_data;
    addr_reg <= w_addr;
    commit_reg <= commit;
end

always @(posedge clk12p5) begin
    if (commit_reg) begin
        busy_reg <= 1'b1;
        scs_reg <= 1'b0;
        sclk_counter <= 5'd0;
        data_counter <= 4'd0;
    end else if (data_counter == 4'd10) begin
        busy_reg <= 1'b0;
        scs_reg <= 1'b1;
    end else begin
        sclk_counter <= sclk_counter + 5'd1;
        if (sclk_counter == 5'd15) begin
            sclk_counter <= 5'd0;
            data_counter <= data_counter + 4'd1;
            sdata_reg <= data_reg[15 - data_counter];
        end
    end
end

assign sclk = sclk_reg;
assign sdata = sdata_reg;
assign scs = scs_reg;
assign busy = busy_reg;

always @(posedge clk12p5) begin
    sclk_reg <= sclk_counter < 5'd8;
end

endmodule
